electionType: Montclair Board of Education, Essex County & Congressional General Election
councilStructure: Township of Montclair operates under Faulkner Act Council-Manager form. Municipal council elections are held in May quadrennially. In November 2026, Montclair voters elect trustees to the Montclair Public Schools Board of Education (Type II elected district), alongside Essex County Executive, County Commissioners, and Federal representatives.
certifiedTaxRateContext: 3.284% Total Certified Tax Rate (2026). Equalization Ratio 78.6%.
unanimousHealthBenefitPledge: Montclair elected officials and BOE trustees adhere to strict state ethics disclosures and public school health benefit contribution regulations (Chapter 44/78).

votingResources.earlyVotingLocation: Montclair Municipal Building (Council Chambers), 205 Claremont Ave, Montclair, NJ 07042
votingResources.electionDayHours: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST on Tuesday, November 3, 2026

boeElection.title: Montclair Public Schools Board of Education
boeElection.budgetOverview: $142.4M Operating Budget (2026–2027) serving 6,100+ students across 11 magnet campuses, plus ongoing oversight of the voter-approved $188M bond referendum for comprehensive school infrastructure restorations.

candidates.name: Jada Roman
candidates.tagline: Equitable educational resources across all wards, modernizing historic facilities, and neurodiverse student support.
priorities: Ensuring the timely and transparent rollout of $188M bond infrastructure upgrades (HVAC, roofs, science labs).
Strengthening Montclair special education programs, IEP services, and bilingual family outreach.
Fiscal discipline to maximize classroom funding under the state 2% property tax cap.

candidates.name: Eric Gideon
candidates.tagline: Rigorous line-item budget analysis, competitive bidding on bond projects, and STEM curriculum enrichment.
priorities: Auditing non-instructional administrative overhead to redirect dollars into classroom teachers and aides.
Independent engineering oversight on multimillion-dollar HVAC and capital replacement contracts.
Expanding advanced placement, coding, and modern arts programs across middle and high schools.

candidates.name: Andrew Haran
candidates.tagline: Contractual stability with educators, transparent collective bargaining, and student-centered policies.
priorities: Retaining top-tier certified teaching talent through competitive, respectful contractual negotiations.
Preventing middle-management budget bloat and prioritizing direct student classroom support.
Fostering transparent monthly public forums between school administration and parents.

candidates.name: Margo Pierson
candidates.role: Montclair School Board Trustee & Former Educator
candidates.tagline: Protecting Montclair cherished magnet school system and expanding early childhood literacy.
priorities: Preserving specialized thematic magnet curricula across all seven Montclair elementary schools.
Implementing evidence-based early reading and phonics programs to close kindergarten-to-3rd grade gaps.
Strict fiscal adherence to long-range capital plans for district heating and ventilation systems.

candidates.name: Holly Reynics
candidates.tagline: Transformative special education services, inclusive classrooms, and mental health resources.
priorities: Overhauling special education case management and reducing bureaucratic delays for IEP evaluations.
Securing state and federal grants to fund on-campus mental wellness clinics and student crisis counselors.
Ensuring complete accessibility compliance (ADA) across all historic multi-story school buildings.

candidates.name: Lynn Simpson
candidates.tagline: Energy-efficient school infrastructure, clean air filtration, and long-term taxpayer savings.
priorities: Transitioning school building HVAC and electrical grids to solar and geothermal energy to cut utility bills.
Eliminating outdated lead service lines and ensuring continuous clean water testing across all campuses.
Promoting outdoor environmental learning, school gardens, and climate science literacy.

candidates.name: Sean Bookhart
candidates.role: Youth Sports Coach & Small Business Owner
candidates.tagline: Youth extracurriculars, athletic facility upgrades, and practical financial management.
priorities: Renovating Woodman Field and secondary athletic complexes for student safety and community use.
Expanding career, trade, and vocational opportunities alongside college preparatory tracks.
Publishing clear, user-friendly monthly BOE budget dashboards for Montclair taxpayers.

candidates.keyIssues: Securing federal infrastructure grants (Gateway Tunnel, NJ Transit), defending public education funding, and expanding the federal State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction.

candidates.keyIssues: Federal spending cuts, deregulation, tax relief, and border security.

boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Applies legal and fiduciary discipline to ensure tax levy growth complies strictly with state 2% caps.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Supervises implementation of the historic multi-million-dollar school facilities modernization program.
